description: Converts IELTS General Training, CELPIP-General, PTE Core, TEF Canada (either the Score / 699 or the Équivalence ancien score column) or TCF Canada ability scores to CLB levels using IRCC equivalency tables. The overall level is the lowest of the four.

test.description: ielts = IELTS General Training; celpip = CELPIP-General; pte = PTE Core; tef = TEF Canada (Score / 699); tefAncien = TEF Canada (Équivalence ancien score); tcf = TCF Canada

name: convert_language_test_to_clb
title: Convert language test scores to CLB
